plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: A card above the Claude Code prompt: context, limits with a Limit Coach, cache and API cost, model and effort, a quote, and an animated cat or dog that grows with your context.

plugins.name: soundtrack
plugins.description: Soft sounds for what Claude is doing: a rising chord when it starts, a quiet tick while tools run, a chime when it's done.

plugins.name: project-colors
plugins.description: Every project gets its own prompt-bar colour and session name, learned from your own /color and /rename.

plugins.name: project-links
plugins.description: A Links pane on the right listing your project's artifacts and important links, read from dashboard/links.json; /links prints them.
